messages:
Ana (Support): customer `acme-inc` says their Org dashboard goes empty when they set Region = ap-southeast and Model = rwx-1.4 (version multi-select). charts show 0 requests. reproducer steps shared below.
Sam (Engineering): can you paste exact repro steps + a screenshot or a gif? does it happen for other time ranges?
Ana (Support): Steps: 1) Console -> Analytics -> Select Org=acme-inc 2) Filters: Region: ap-southeast, Model: "rwx-1.4" and Version: (none) 3) Time range: Last 7 days 4) Click Apply -> charts go blank. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.test/aclips/repogif1.gif
Ana (Support): Also tried toggling model multiselect to include rwx-1.4 and rwx-1.3 together -> then data appears (sparse) which suggests filter intersection is dropping rwx-1.4 alone.
Jess (Platform): hmm we've seen normalization differences before with hyphenated model names. Frontend normalizer may be `rwx-1.4` but the metrics ingestion normalizes to `rwx_1.4`. If filters compare raw strings, they won't match.
Mike (Ops): pulled the analytics query from the UI when the filters are applied. Query sent to metrics service: 
```json
{
  "filters": {
    "region": "ap-southeast",
    "model": ["rwx-1.4"]
  },
  "group_by": ["model"],
  "range": {"start": "2026-03-10", "end": "2026-03-17"}
}
```
Mike (Ops): backend service returned empty buckets for model `rwx-1.4`. Raw metrics keys observed in the ingestion index: `rwx_1.4`, `rwx-1.3`, `rwx_v1`.
Sam (Engineering): oh — so ingestion normalizes hyphens to underscores for some models during tokenization/aliasing. Frontend sends original alias. That's a mismatch.
Sam (Engineering): can you reproduce with a direct API call (bypass UI)? try curling the analytics service with both model keys.
Ana (Support): performed curl against analytics API:
```bash
curl -X POST https://analytics.prod.redwood/api/query -d '{"filters":{"region":"ap-southeast","model":["rwx-1.4"]},"range":{"start":"2026-03-10","end":"2026-03-17"}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
Ana (Support): Response: `{ "buckets": [] }`
Ana (Support): Now curl with model underscore:
```bash
curl -X POST https://analytics.prod.redwood/api/query -d '{"filters":{"region":"ap-southeast","model":["rwx_1.4"]},"range":{"start":"2026-03-10","end":"2026-03-17"}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
Ana (Support): Response: `{ "buckets": [{"model":"rwx_1.4","count":324}] }`
Sam (Engineering): confirms mismatch. Root cause hypothesis: a recent ingestion normalization change (PR #4821) replaced non-alphanumeric with underscores for index keys. Frontend filter builder does not apply same normalization.
Jess (Platform): I can put together a quick mapping shim in the console to normalize outgoing filter keys the same way ingestion does. That would be a frontend hotfix.
Mike (Ops): there's also risk that other dashboards rely on raw aliases; best to make backend accept both forms for a short window. fallback mapping in the analytics service would be safer immediate fix.
Sam (Engineering): action items: 1) Patch analytics query layer to also match underscore/hyphen variants (hotfix) 2) Deploy frontend shim to normalize filters (follow-up) 3) Add a migration note to ingestion docs.
Sam (Engineering): I'll open an infra bug and a rollback candidate for the ingestion normalization. Ticket: INT-3109.
Sam (Engineering): tagging @jess_platform for frontend quickfix and @mike_ops for hotfix rollout plan.
deploy-bot: deploy: analytics-query v3.12.4 started to canary in prod in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-17T14:02:00Z
Mike (Ops): canary is limited but this explains why some regions saw dropouts. Suggest we pause canary and push a patch to translate incoming filter keys.
Sam (Engineering): I'll pause canary and open PR for the translation layer. Pausing canary now.
deploy-bot: deploy: analytics-query v3.12.4 paused at 2026-03-17T14:05:12Z
Ana (Support): Workaround for customer: remove Model filter or use model key with underscore `rwx_1.4` or use wildcard `rwx*`. Sent to customer with steps.
Ana (Support): Customer confirmed using `rwx*` shows data, they're happy for now but asked for ETA on permanent fix.
Jess (Platform): ETA: frontend shim in next patch (2d), backend fallback hotfix (today, 2-3hr rolling). Will update INT-3109 with timeline.
Sam (Engineering): assigning to me to deliver backend hotfix. I'll also include a unit test confirming both keys match.
Mike (Ops): postmortem note: ingestion normalization change was insufficiently coordinated with console team. Add checklist for future index-key normalization changes.
Ana (Support): thanks everyone. I'll follow up with customer when backend hotfix is live and confirm charts restored. :thumbsup:
Sam (Engineering): closing loop: hotfix merged, canary rollout resumed. Please reopen if customer sees anything else.
deploy-bot: deploy: analytics-query v3.12.5 started canary at 2026-03-17T17:58:00Z
Ana (Support): Customer confirmed charts restored at 17:20 UTC. Closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
